train.spec: A classic 3x3 sliding tile puzzle with six levels that get steadily harder.
Tower of Hanoi with three pegs where each level adds one more disk.
Lights Out on a 3x3 grid: pressing a lamp toggles it and its neighbours.
Two water jugs of different sizes; measure an exact amount by filling, emptying and pouring.
A 1D sliding puzzle: a row of numbered tiles with one gap, sort them in ascending order.
Coin flip puzzle: a row of coins, each move flips a coin and its neighbours; make all heads.
A robot on a small grid with walls must reach the exit; later levels have longer mazes.
Three water buckets with different capacities; reach a target volume in any bucket.
A stack-sorting puzzle where coloured disks move between towers until each tower is one colour.
Rotate rows and columns of a 3x3 number grid to restore sorted order.
Lamps in a ring: toggling one lamp also toggles the two lamps beside it. Turn all lamps off.
A frog-jumping puzzle: frogs on lily pads swap sides by sliding or hopping over one frog.

heldout.spec: A 2x3 sliding tile puzzle with five or more levels of increasing difficulty.
A river-crossing puzzle with a farmer, a wolf, a goat and a cabbage, with harder variants per level.
Switches wired to bulbs on a 2x4 board; flipping a switch toggles a fixed set of bulbs.
Pour liquid between a 3-litre and a 5-litre jug, with new jug sizes on later levels.
Move a stack of disks between four pegs (Reve's puzzle) with more disks on each level.
Push a single box onto a target on a tiny warehouse grid, sokoban style.
A peg-swap puzzle: red and blue pegs in a line trade places using the empty hole.
A counter puzzle: start at 1 and reach a target number using +3 and x2 buttons.
